name: Oxaprozin

own_problems.text: Carries a boxed warning in United States — for heart harm, nerve and brain harm and stomach and gut problems

5.1 Cardiovascular Thrombotic Events Clinical trials of several cyclooxygenase-2 (COX-2) selective and nonselective NSAIDs of up to three years duration have shown an increased risk of serious cardiovascular (CV) thrombotic events, including myocardial infarction (MI) and stroke, which can be fatal. summary: Oxaprozin carries the FDA's strongest warning in the United States for stomach and gut problems, nerve and brain harm, and heart harm such as fatal strokes and heart attacks [3][4]. Clinical trials of similar drugs over up to three years showed that this increased chance of serious blood clots and heart issues can happen early in treatment [4]. Based on a small computer model rather than tests on people, this drug received a high risk score of 74 for liver harm and a low risk score of 26 for heart harm [M].
